title: Echomist: Refined Plating
description: Adds Cuprolite, a material focused on defense!
body:
![Echomist: Refined Plating](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebdf3b22e84f38ffa042b902eff979d29f670ebb.png)
---
This mods adds a new material, Cuprolite, which focused on a defense-oriented playstyle!

### Features
- Cuprolite Alloy: Main Resource of the mod, crafted with 2 Copper Ingots and one Sculk Block.
- Cuprolite Greatsword: A slow, but hard hitting weapon that can chain lightning between targets.
- Cuprolite Cell: A combat-oriented utility item, which ,when used, applies Stasis to the user.
> Stasis is an effect that "freezes" the duration of your current effects whilst making you unaffected from new effects.
- Cuprolite Magnet: Increases the item pickup range when held in the offhand.
- Cuprolite Armor: Offers more defense than Netherite Armor with the trade-off of reduced movement speed.
> Iron Armor can be upgraded using Cuprolite Upgrade Templates and Cuprolite Blocks in order to get Cuprolite Armor. 
- Blocks
  - Cuprolite Blocks (Including Stairs, Slabs and Walls)
  - Cuprolite Bricks (Including Stairs, Slabs and Walls)
  - Cuprolite Tiles (Including Stairs, Slabs and Walls)
  - Cuprolite Grates (Including Stairs and Slabs)
  - Cuprolite Pillar
  - Chiseled Cuprolite
  - Cuprolite Bulb
- Cuprolite Upgrade Template, which is found in Ominous Vaults (10% chance)

Cuprolite Alloys can be used to trim armor!

---
### About Echomist

Echomist is an ongoing, work-in-progress mod series.
More is coming soon, development progress can be viewed on the [Discord](https://discord.gg/gRFRDhFn2p)!

This mod will not be ported to other mod loaders or versions, unless I am willing to do so.

Due to ARR licensing, you are not allowed to use any code / textures / other assets from this project. This is intentional, as I do not want my work to be used in any unrelated projects. Deciding against it, will result in me asking you to remove said assets from your project + further steps if the issue is not addressed. If you are really wanting to use certain assets, DM me on discord.
